## **Presión publicitaria** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Presión publicitaria.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona presión publicitaria.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 ago 2026 - 24 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios notan presión publicitaria. Señala fricción de monetización y una apertura para un competidor más limpio.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Robyn Scott_, 24 ago 2026, 3/5: "Ads are slow to load and cause the page to shift just as you're about to touch your screen. Audio in ads is annoying and takes over other audio. Otherwise, this is the best tracking app I've ran across, but I won't recommend it until the ad issued are gone."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 ago 2026 - 24 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _nick villiers_, 24 ago 2026, 4/5: "Overall FP is good app to log your calories and macros. Luckily the sub doesn't paywall most of the features, like meals, food entry limits ect. I'm taking it down to four stars mainly because they don't give you barcode scanning in the free plan. Either way it's good enough so I don't have to vibe code an alternative for myself. Good job."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 6 may 2026 - 24 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Vipul Uchil_, 23 ago 2026, 1/5: "app is more or less unusable after the latest update, which is definitely vibe coded because some MBA decided to fire all the UX professionals at the company. they took a perfectly intuitive and functional app and destroyed it for no reason at all. the new app is not user friendly in any way, actively prevents you from finding information, prevents you from quickly logging food. why would you ever use a food logging app when it takes you forever to log a single item of food? use cronometer."
            2. _enka cacka_, 21 ago 2026, 1/5: "broken app, checkout doesnt work, guided onboarding flashing and annoying, cant add a meal adds pop up and screen freeze. what a joke"
            3. _Ein Google-Nutzer_, 16 ago 2026, 1/5: "Demands an insane amount of access to your personal data. Also, the amount of ads has increased to a level that makes the app unusable."
<!--/ir-theme-->
